project_name: AEGIS — Personal AI Agent & Governance Control Center
archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Web3 Private Inference & Human Proof)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

layout_and_spacing.hero_layout: Full viewport height with dynamic particle mesh canvas, glowing floating card, and dual CTAs
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 min-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8
layout_and_spacing.main_chat_span: lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col h-[750px] border border-cyan-500/20 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden
layout_and_spacing.modal_backdrop: fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-2xl flex items-center justify-center p-4
layout_and_spacing.modal_content: relative w-full max-w-xl bg-slate-950/90 border border-violet-500/40 rounded-3xl p-8 shadow-[0_0_80px_rgba(139,92,246,0.3)] overflow-hidden

landing_hero.title: Your AI. Under Your Control.
landing_hero.tagline: 0G Verified Private Compute × World ID Biometric Governance
landing_hero.bg_effect: 3D-style animated Canvas particles/neural mesh with reactive mouse glowing orb

agent_console.left_sidebar: Agent ID badge, TEE Status indicator, Current Autonomy Mode selector, World ID verification indicator, active compute node hash
agent_console.chat_canvas: Message feed with explicit 0G private inference badge, real-time typing state, simulated request IDs, and live thinking indicators
agent_console.human_gate_trigger: High-risk actions (e.g., wallet transfers, contract deployment, private key access) trigger the World ID modal directly from chat

world_id_modal.archetype: The Emotional Peak of the Product
world_id_modal.visuals: Orbicular biometric scanner animation, glowing radial rings, dark crystal backdrop
action_paths: Approve (Simulated Orb Iris Scan success with green particle burst)
Deny (User rejects request with red glow & cancellation rationale)
Expiry Countdown (15-second timer with circular progress bar that triggers auto-abort on timeout)

autonomy_policy_editor.layout: Interactive matrix for low, medium, and high-risk action categories
autonomy_policy_editor.toggles: Instant Auto-Approve, Require World ID Human Gate, Always Deny
autonomy_policy_editor.visuals: Linear-style slider switches, active risk badge indicators, live policy hash calculator

audit_log_timeline.layout: Vertical stream with crisp 0G proof links, status badges, timestamping, and verification path (Auto vs Human Verified)

settings_and_identity.layout: Tabbed configuration panel for Profile, World ID Zero-Knowledge Proof status, 0G Node Endpoint, and Cryptographic Keys

micro_interactions.tracing_beam: Hovering over governance cards highlights a subtle 1px gradient tracing line around the container border
micro_interactions.button_press: Framer motion scale-95 tap effects with instant neon shadow glow expansion
micro_interactions.og_thinking_indicator: Pulsing cyan-violet dual ring animation with monospace request hash stream
micro_interactions.toast_notifications: Sonner dark glass toast notifications anchored bottom-right for human proof verifications

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, inputs, policy toggles, modal triggers, and status badges MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='launch-agent-btn', data-testid='world-id-approve-btn', data-testid='autonomy-rule-toggle-transfer')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: All text elements satisfy minimum 4.5:1 contrast against dark background layers using text-slate-100 or text-cyan-300 on #05070F.
